sections.label: Assets under management growth
sections.summary: AUM grew an average 15% per annum over five years, reaching S$3.3 trillion at end-2017.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: Assets under management (AUM) have grown by an average of 15% per annum over the past five years, reaching S$3.3 trillion at the end of 2017.

sections.label: Fund management industry value-add
sections.summary: The fund management industry contributed 12.4% of the financial sector's nominal value-add last year.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The fund management industry is an important component of Singapore’s financial sector, contributing 12.4% of the overall financial sector’s nominal value-add last year.

sections.label: Investment funds domiciled elsewhere
sections.summary: Many investment funds managed in Singapore are domiciled elsewhere, such as Luxembourg and the Cayman Islands, due to flexible corporate structures.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: A substantial proportion of investment funds that are managed by fund managers in Singapore are domiciled elsewhere, for example, in Luxembourg and the Cayman Islands, owing to the flexible corporate structures that are available there.

sections.label: VCC framework job estimate
sections.summary: MAS estimated the VCC framework could create over 1,000 new jobs for service providers in its first two years.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: MAS has estimated that the VCC framework could create over 1,000 new jobs for service providers in the first two years of its introduction.

sections.label: Sub-fund asset segregation requirement
sections.summary: The Bill requires each sub-fund's assets and liabilities to be segregated, so one sub-fund's assets cannot discharge another's liabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: As a safeguard for VCC shareholders and to enhance creditor protection, the Bill requires the assets and liabilities of each sub-fund to be segregated, such that the assets of one sub-fund cannot be used to discharge the liabilities of the umbrella fund, or of another sub-fund.

sections.label: Alternative AUM growth rates
sections.summary: Alternative AUM grew 20% per annum over five years, led by venture capital and private equity, while traditional AUM grew 13% per annum.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: Alternative AUM in Singapore grew by 20% per annum over the past five years, led by the venture capital and private equity sectors.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: In comparison, traditional AUM grew by 13% per annum over the same period.

sections.label: Re-domiciliation for overseas investment funds
sections.summary: The Bill provides a re-domiciliation mechanism for existing overseas investment funds constituted as corporate structures similar to VCCs.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: To facilitate fund domiciliation in Singapore, the Bill will provide a re-domiciliation mechanism for existing overseas investment funds constituted as corporate structures similar to VCCs.

sections.label: VCC Bill amendments and benefits
sections.summary: The VCC Bill will be amended in 2019 to align insolvency with other corporate structures, with tax framework set separately.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The VCC Bill will be amended in 2019 to align the VCC insolvency regime with those of other corporate structures under the Insolvency, Restructuring and Dissolution Bill which has just been debated.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The tax framework for VCCs will be separately set out in legislative amendments to the relevant tax legislation.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The introduction of the VCC framework will enhance our fund ecosystem and the value proposition Singapore offers to fund managers.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The benefits of the VCC are not solely confined to fund managers, but will also extend to local service providers.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: It will benefit the Singapore economy, strengthen Singapore’s position as a full-service international fund management centre and create good jobs for Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har (West Coast)
sentences.text: AUM has more than doubled in five years, from S$1.6 trillion in 2012 to $3.3 trillion in 2017.

sections.label: Overseas domiciled AUM share
sections.summary: Close to 80% of AUM managed in Singapore are still domiciled overseas.

sentences.speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har (West Coast)
sentences.text: Close to 80% of AUM managed in Singapore are still domiciled overseas.

sections.label: Incentives to spur VCC adoption
sections.summary: The Government should consider sweeteners such as cost subsidies to overcome inertia and cost hurdles in adopting the VCC structure.

sentences.speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har (West Coast)
sentences.text: We must actively promote the structure to drive adoption and consider incentives that may be necessary to spur action amongst fund managers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har (West Coast)
sentences.text: So, Deputy Speaker, Sir, to overcome the initial inertia to adopt the VCC structure, including the cost hurdles for adoption, the Government should consider some "sweeteners", perhaps in the form of cost subsidies, when setting up a VCC structure in Singapore.

sections.label: VCC framework for Asia investments
sections.summary: With two-thirds of AUM in Asia Pacific and 40% in ASEAN, the VCC framework should be operationalised to compete as a fund management location.

sentences.speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har (West Coast)
sentences.text: With two-thirds of Singapore’s AUM invested in the Asia Pacific and 40% in the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN), the VCC framework should be operationalised to enable us to compete strongly as a choice location for setting up fund management operations focused on investments in Asia and ASEAN.

sections.label: MAS-regulated fund manager requirement
sections.summary: VCCs in Singapore require a MAS-regulated fund manager based in Singapore subject to anti-money laundering obligations, in line with international standards.

sentences.speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har (West Coast)
sentences.text: Unlike other fund domiciliation centres, VCCs in Singapore require the appointment of a fund manager regulated by MAS to be based in Singapore and subject to anti-money laundering (AML) obligations, in line with international standards.

sentences.speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har (West Coast)
sentences.text: This will help prevent VCCs from being abused for unlawful purposes and prevent Singapore from becoming an offshore centre without actual investment management activities conducted in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har (West Coast)
sentences.text: These will include lawyers, fund administrators, fund custodians, tax professionals and accountants, all attractive jobs for Singaporeans.

sections.label: Concern over qualified professionals
sections.summary: The industry has concerns about the availability of qualified professionals, including fund directors.

sentences.speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har (West Coast)
sentences.text: One particular area that the industry has concerns about is the availability of qualified professionals, including fund directors.

sections.label: VCC share issuance and redemption
sections.summary: A Singapore VCC can issue and redeem shares without shareholders' approval, letting investors exit when they wish and pay dividends using capital.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: For example, a Singapore VCC will be able to issue and redeem shares without shareholders' approval, enabling investors to exit their investments in the investment fund when they wish to and pay dividends using capital.

sections.label: Accounting standards for VCCs
sections.summary: VCCs can use International Financial Reporting Standards and US GAAP, in addition to Singapore accounting standards and recommended accounting principles.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: VCCs will be able to use International Financial Reporting Standards and US GAAP, in addition to Singapore accounting standards and recommended accounting principles.

sections.label: MAS study of VCC tax regime
sections.summary: MAS is studying the tax regime for VCCs, including extending current fund vehicle tax schemes, and welcomes feedback; a question asks if VCCs qualify for tax incentives.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: In this regard, MAS is studying the tax regime for VCCs, including exploring the feasibility of extending the current fund vehicle tax schemes to VCCs, and welcomes feedback on the VCC tax regime." I would like to ask if VCCs would be eligible to receive the current Government tax incentives available to investment companies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: For example, will VCCs be eligible for Singapore fund tax incentive schemes currently provided for under sections 13R, 13X and 13Y of the Income Tax Act and the Financial Sector Incentive (FSI) scheme?

sections.label: Easy exit and tax exemptions
sections.summary: It allows investors to exit easily, and existing tax exemptions will be extended to this new company type.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: It allows investors to exit their investments easily.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: And as the Second Minister clarified in his 2018 Budget Statement, existing tax exemptions will be extended to this new company type.

sections.label: Singapore tax haven rankings
sections.summary: In 2016 Oxfam labelled Singapore the fifth worst corporate tax haven, and this year Tax Justice Network ranked Singapore fifth on its Financial Secrecy Index.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: In 2016, UK charity Oxfam labelled Singapore the "fifth worst" corporate tax haven in the world.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: This year, Tax Justice Network, a global non-government organisation (NGO), ranked Singapore fifth on its Financial Secrecy Index.

sections.label: Benefits of VCCs for Singaporeans
sections.summary: A question asks the Second Minister to estimate or outline the benefits of establishing VCCs in Singapore for the average Singaporean.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Can the Second Minister provide an estimate or outline of the benefits that the establishment of VCCs in Singapore would bring for the average Singaporean?

sections.label: VCC investor exit and dividends
sections.summary: For VCCs, investors can exit their investments when they wish and can pay dividends using the fund's capital.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: For VCCs, investors have the flexibility to exit their investments when they wish to, and they can pay the dividends using the fund's capital.

sections.label: VCC Bill portfolio inflows potential
sections.summary: The VCC Bill could possibly see larger portfolio inflows and foreign collective investment schemes re-domiciled as VCCs here.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: The current volume may be small as we proceed with the VCC Bill, if it is approved, but as we build depth and breadth in this sector, its impact on our financial account flows can be substantial in the future.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Thus, the implementation of the VCC Bill could possibly see a larger number of portfolio inflows.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Additionally, there is also potential for foreign corporate entities that were initially established as collective investment schemes to be re-domiciled as VCCs here.

sections.label: Accounting standards for VCCs
sections.summary: VCCs can use local accounting standards, International Financial Reporting Standards and the US GAAP.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Aside from local accounting standards, International Financial Reporting Standards and the US GAAP can also be used by VCCs.

sections.label: Fund vehicles and double taxation agreements
sections.summary: Trusts, LLPs and companies were fund set-up vehicles, but only companies have access to Singapore's double taxation agreement network.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: Hitherto, there were three vehicles for fund set-up, as the hon Second Minister mentioned: trusts, limited liability partnerships (LLPs) and companies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: However, only companies, as compared to trust and LLPs, have access to Singapore's network of avoidance of double taxation agreements (DTAs).

sections.label: VCCs address these problems
sections.summary: The introduction of the VCCs would address all these problems directly.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: All these problems would be addressed directly by the introduction of the VCCs.

sections.label: MAS-regulated fund managers safeguard
sections.summary: Only MAS-regulated fund managers may operate funds under the VCC corporate structure.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: At the same time, there are safeguards in that only MAS-regulated fund managers might operate the funds under the VCC corporate structure.

sections.label: Sub-fund asset segregation requirement
sections.summary: The Bill will require sub-funds' assets and liabilities to be segregated so one sub-fund's assets cannot discharge others' liabilities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: This will encourage fund managers to have the domicile of their investment funds here.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: I am pleased to note that the Bill will be requiring the assets and liabilities of different sub-funds to be segregated so that the assets of one may not be used to discharge the liabilities of the others.

sections.label: MAS considered and rejected option
sections.summary: MAS considered this but decided against it.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: MAS did, in fact, consider this, but decided against it.

sections.label: Tax exemptions extended to VCCs
sections.summary: Sections 13R and 13X exemptions, the 10% Financial Sector Incentive rate, and GST remission for funds will be extended to VCCs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The tax exemptions under sections 13R and 13X of the Income Tax Act will be extended to VCCs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The 10% concessionary tax rate under the Financial Sector Incentive – Fund Management Scheme will be extended to approved fund managers managing incentivised VCCs, and the existing Goods and Services Tax (GST) remission for funds will be extended to incentivised VCCs.

sections.label: Sub-fund access to tax treaties
sections.summary: Singapore will allow a sub-fund of a VCC resident entity to access Singapore's tax treaties.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Singapore will allow a sub-fund, being part of a VCC resident entity, to access Singapore's tax treaties.

sections.label: VCC re-domiciliation requirements
sections.summary: The VCC framework will adopt requirements similar to the Companies Act inward re-domiciliation regime, without a minimum size requirement.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The VCC framework will adopt similar requirements as the inward re-domiciliation regime under the Companies Act (Cap 50).

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: We will, however, not require re-domiciling entities to be of a certain minimum size in terms of assets, revenue and employees, as investment funds are inherently different from operating companies.

sections.label: Local funds restructuring to VCC
sections.summary: Existing local funds that are companies, unit trusts or LLPs can restructure to adopt the VCC structure by incorporating a new VCC and transferring assets.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Existing local funds which are companies, unit trusts or LLPs can restructure to adopt the VCC structure, for example, by incorporating a new VCC and transferring the assets to the VCC.

sections.label: Widening VCC framework scope
sections.summary: MAS will consider widening the scope of the VCC framework with appropriate modifications for other sectors in subsequent reviews.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: MAS will consider widening the scope of the VCC framework with appropriate modifications for applications in other sectors, in subsequent reviews.

sections.label: Training for VCC skills
sections.summary: MAS is engaging local fund service providers and training providers to identify competency gaps and develop training programmes for industry professionals serving VCCs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: MAS is engaging local fund service providers as well as training providers to identify potential competency gaps and develop training programmes to ensure that industry professionals have the requisite skills to cater to the needs of VCCs.

sections.label: Attracting global fund managers
sections.summary: MAS has taken the lead to foster and promote a conducive environment for fund managers to attract global fund managers and deepen their investment capabilities.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: To attract global fund managers and deepen their investment capabilities here, MAS has taken the lead to foster and promote a conducive environment for fund managers.

sections.label: Monitoring VCC adoption and incentives
sections.summary: MAS will monitor the adoption and take-up of the VCC structure and consider whether specific incentives are needed to encourage more fund managers to set up VCC funds.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Nonetheless, MAS will monitor the adoption and take-up of the VCC structure and consider whether specific incentives are needed to encourage more fund managers to set up funds as VCCs.

sections.label: AML/CFT safeguards for VCCs
sections.summary: MAS has put in place two levels of safeguards, first imposing AML/CFT requirements on VCCs to conduct due diligence checks and monitoring of all shareholders, including looking through nominees.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: In crafting the policies for VCCs, we have considered these risks and put in place two levels of safeguards to address them, taking reference from international standards.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: First, we will impose anti-money laundering and countering the financing of terrorism (AML/CFT) requirements on VCCs, essentially requiring them to conduct due diligence checks and monitoring of all VCC shareholders, including looking through any nominees to the controllers behind them.

sections.label: ACRA director removal powers
sections.summary: ACRA may direct removal or replacement of a director it finds not fit and proper, if necessary for the VCC, its shareholders or the public.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: ACRA may direct the removal or replacement of a director who it is satisfied is not fit and proper, where it is necessary in the interests of the VCC, the VCC’s shareholders, or the public, to do so.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: I agree with Mr Louis Ng that Singapore should not be perceived as a tax haven.

sections.label: Fund manager complaints low
sections.summary: Complaints against fund managers averaged 13 per year over the past five years, a relatively low number.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The number of complaints has been relatively low, on an average of 13 complaints per year against fund managers over the past five years.

sections.label: New VCC corporate structure
sections.summary: The new VCC structure will help position Singapore as a fund domiciliation hub, attract funds, create business opportunities and enhance competitiveness while maintaining its reputation.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The new VCC corporate structure is a game changer which will help position Singapore to be a fund domiciliation hub and enhance the value proposition to fund managers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: It will attract more funds to domicile here, and provide new business opportunities for lawyers, accountants, fund administrators and fund custodians.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: It will enhance our international competitiveness as a leading fund management hub and financial centre, while providing safeguards to maintain Singapore’s reputation as a clean and trusted hub.
